caption: The drawing depicts a single brown glass bottle with a square base and a tall neck, rendered in tones of amber and brown. The bottle features detailed decorative ridges running vertically along its four corners, resembling a beaded or ribbed pattern. Embossed text is visible on the upper front face of the bottle, reading “DR. R. R. KIRKE 1850 PLANTATION BITTERS." The bottle has a short, cylindrical neck topped with a brown stopper or cork. The bottle is centered on a plain, light beige or off-white background. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the artist’s name "Dorothy Brennan" is neatly written.
title: Bitters Bottle
